name: agents-supervisor
description: Supervisor plugins that catch premature agent stops and re-prompt the agent to finish — for Claude Code and OpenCode.

plugins.name: supervisor
plugins.description: Catches premature agent stops and re-prompts to finish. Dataset-backed Stop-hook supervisor with /supervisor:train and /supervisor:status. Includes plainspeak, a Stop hook that catches fluffy replies and injects a plain-English rewrite directive.
